maddeler.e:
استكثرا (form X)
# اِسْتَكْثَرَا (istakṯarā) /is.tak.θa.raː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَكْثَرَ (istakṯara)
# اُسْتُكْثِرَا (ustukṯirā) /us.tuk.θi.raː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَكْثَرَ (istakṯara)
# اِسْتَكْثِرَا (istakṯirā) /is.tak.θi.raː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَكْثَرَ (istakṯara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
